programme.desc: Leah and Zac want to twirl, leap, and reenact their new favorite ballet, Swan Lake. Leah wishes to be a ballerina like the Swan Queen, but the genies mistakenly make her a queen of real swans!

programme.title: Shimmer and Shine
programme.desc: Leah notices Zac the Magician's magic tricks aren't going well, so she calls on her genies for some real magic assistance. But Shimmer and Shine aren't getting the tricks right either, and the girls have a magical mess to fix!

programme.title: Shimmer and Shine
programme.desc: It's Christmas Eve, and Leah is transported to the North Pole! After Leah accidentally wishes Santa to a tropical island and the elves asleep, it's up to the girls to deliver the presents and save Christmas... genie-style!

programme.title: Shimmer and Shine
programme.desc: Astronauts Leah and Zac are on a quest to speak to an alien through their walkie talkies. When Leah wishes to be able to talk to one, Shimmer and Shine poof an alien into her backyard, where she can talk to one face to face!

programme.desc: Diane suggests Carla consult a psychologist to learn to control her temper.

programme.desc: Coach discourages his daughter from marrying her pompous and rude fiancé.

programme.title: Cheers

programme.title: Cheers

programme.title: Cheers

programme.title: Cheers
programme.desc: Coach feels he can't compete with Sam when they fall for the same woman.

programme.title: Cheers
programme.desc: Sam loans out his lucky cap to a baseball player who's in a slump.

programme.title: Cheers
programme.desc: Inebriated for the first time in his life, a timid young priest-to-be makes an amorous advance toward Diane and concludes he's not fit for the monastery.

programme.title: Cheers

programme.title: Cheers
programme.desc: A casting agent pursues Sam, offering more than just a business proposition.

programme.title: Cheers
programme.desc: Saddened by the death of her cat, Diane gains little sympathy from the Cheers clan and begins to reevaluate her relationships with everyone, especially Sam.

programme.title: Cheers
programme.desc: Diane is aghast when a very pregnant Carla tricks the surprised, but ecstatic egghead Marshall Lipton into believing he's the father.

programme.title: Cheers
programme.desc: Sam's shocked when his ex-teammate comes out of the closet at the bar.

programme.title: Cheers
programme.desc: Sam unknowingly hires and ex-murderer to escort Diane on a double date.

programme.title: Cheers
programme.desc: Sam enters a photo of Diane in the annual Miss Boston Barmaid contest.

programme.title: Cheers
programme.desc: Sam tries to set up a sting to catch a crooked poker player. When Sam learns that a conman has taken thousands of dollars from Coach, he turns to Harry "The Hat" to help them get the money back.

programme.title: Cheers

programme.title: Cheers
programme.desc: Sam is chagrined when his brother captivates everyone at Cheers, especially Diane, whose budding romance with the dashing Derek sparks Sam's jealously and confusion.

programme.title: Cheers
programme.desc: Sam and Diane are forced to come to grips with their feelings about each other when Diane's relationship with Sam's brother grows more serious.

programme.desc: Carla's new love interest could die from too much excitement.

programme.desc: Sam's newly divorced friend tries to come between him and Diane.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cet épisode est la bataille final entre les pro X-BOX one et PS4, les deux clans plmus que jamais divisés vont se battre jusqu'au bout pour défendre leur console préférée.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Les enfants de South Park découvre Photoshop et son pouvoir d'amélioration physique. Et Wendy va tout faire pour montrer aux garçons que ce n'est pas la vérité.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Afin de ne plus être obligés d'aller à l'école ou de faire quoi que ce soit, Stan, Kyle, Cartman, Kenny et Butters décident de créer leur startup en utilisant Kickstarter pour la financer.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: M. Mackey agace tout le monde à propos de son régime alimentaire sans gluten. Après avoir été témoins des risques liés au gluten, les habitants changent radicalement leur comportement alimentaire.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Dans le but d'utiliser les toilettes des filles pour échapper aux toilettes bondés des garçons, Cartman annonce qu'il est transgenre. Pendant ce temps, Randy se démène avec sa double identité de Lorde.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Le nouveau service de transport de Timmy destiné à recueillir des fonds pour le camp d'été lui fait beaucoup d'ennemis.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cartman découvre les drônes et en profite pour filmer l'intimité des habitants de South Park. Ce qui va entraîner une paranoïa autour de l'utilisation des drônes.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Stan devient accro au nouveau jeu sur mobile produit par le Canada, mettant en scène Terrance et Philippe. L'application est dite 'gratuite' mais propose de dépenser de l'argent pour progresser dans le jeu.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cartman a acheté l'Oculus Rift et les enfants ne savent plus s'ils sont dans le monde réel ou dans le monde virtuel.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Kenny excelle dans le jeu de carte Magic : l'assemblée ou les combats de coqs font rage dans les milieux underground. Randy, pensant qu'il s'agit de tout autre chose mais se trompe.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Ike ne veut plus jouer avec Kyle à Call of Duty et préfère regarder des personnes jouant et commentant le jeu sur YouTube

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Les hologrammes de stars décédées envahissent la télévision : le monde court à la catastrophe dont il ne pourrait jamais se relever.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Les garçons expriment tout le respect qu'ils ont pour Caitlyn Jenner dans cette épisode de la série South Park, plus magnifique et courageuse que jamais.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: M. Garrison veut construire un mur pour tenir à distance les immigrants sans papiers.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: La ville de South Park entreprend d'importantes rénovations. De son côté, Kenny pense qu'il est temps pour lui de chercher un travail.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cartman est persuadé d'être le meilleur critique gastronomique du net que South Park ait connu.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cartman se fait humilier sur les réseaux sociaux à cause de son poids.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Les élèves asiatiques de l'école représentent en peinture l'amour imaginaire entre Tweek et Craig.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Les habitants de South Park ne veulent plus de policiers dans leur ville.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Jimmy, le rédacteur en chef du journal de l'école, se heurte à l'opinion un peu obtue de Principal PC.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Principal PC disparaît avec deux élèves de CM1.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Kyle mène son combat aux côtés d'une alliée dangereuse au détriment de son amitié avec Stan.
programme.sub-title: Le jugement final de Principal PC

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: La poire à lavement devance le sandwich au caca dans la course à la présidence, et cela ne l'arrange pas. J.J. Abrams a pour mission de faire un reboot de l'hymne américain et Kyle veut démasquer le troll qui harcèle les filles de l'école

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Le troll chasseauxgarces42 sévit toujours. Les filles sont de plus en plus remontées et menacent les garçons de répliquer si le harcèlement continue. Ceux-ci sont persuadés que Cartman est responsable et ils comptent bien l'arrêter.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Tous deux privés de technologie, Cartman et Heidi se lient d'amitié. La guerre est ouverte entre Freja Ollegard et chasseauxgarces42 qui a peur d'être découvert. M. Garrison fait tout pour ne pas être élu président.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Alors que Kyle soutient les filles, Butters préfère mener la révolte des garçons. Kyle demande l'aide de Cartman, mais ce dernier refuse. L'identité de Gerald a été découverte par un autre troll qui le met en garde face aux Danois.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Les trolls s'unissent pour contrecarrer les plans des Danois. Cartman et Heidi encouragent les élèves de l'école à se serrer les coudes, tandis que M. Garrison s'attire la colère de ses sympathisants.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cartman et Heidi révèlent leur plan à Kyle. Grâce à Heidi, les Danois lancent leur site. Un premier troll est découvert à Fort Collins. Randy et M. Garrison tentent de détruire sans succès les Rappel-baies qui passent alors à l'action.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Le pays est sous le choc du résultat des élections. Gerald est envoyé en mission secrète au Danemark par Mme Clinton afin d'utiliser le site anti-trolls contre M. Garrison. Bill Clinton et Bill Cosby font la morale aux élèves de l'école.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Les Rappel-baies envahissent la Maison-Blanche. M. Garrison prend ses fonctions mais ne sait pas quoi faire face à l'attaque des Danois. Gerald force Ike à troller à sa place. Cartman et Heidi font la queue pour aller sur Mars.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Kyle convainc les habitants de South Park de demander au président de bombarder le Danemark, mais le regrette très vite. Gerald obtient un entretien avec le soi-disant chasseur de trolls danois. Cartman a peur de perdre Heidi.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cartman a percé le secret des femmes et veut empêcher les hommes d'aller sur Mars. Gerald affronte le chasseur de trolls en face à face. De son côté, Kyle tente de sauver le monde.
programme.sub-title: Rien ne sera plus jamais comme avant

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Randy découvre ce que cela signifie d'être blanc dans la société d'aujourd'hui.
programme.sub-title: Des blancs qui rénovent des maisons

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: La Corée du Nord prend South Park comme cible.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Un lien indéniable se crée entre un homme blanc et un Amérindien.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Facebook est l'arme ultime pour le Professor Chaos.
programme.sub-title: Le prequel du Coon et sa bande

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.desc: Shredder et Stockman la mouche tiennent enfin la substance indispensable pour mettre au point leur formule de contrôle de la pensée.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja

programme.title: The Penguins of Madagascar
programme.desc: When the Penguins lose access to their favorite snack, popcorn, Skipper and crew leap into action to gain a new supply of the salty treat. When a camera falls from the sky into the lemur habitat, Julien and Maurice argue about who keeps the toy.

programme.title: The Penguins of Madagascar
programme.desc: When the zoo installs web cams to bring in new visitors, Private accidentally becomes an Internet star. Skipper accidentally causes King Julien to lose his beloved crown. The penguins go on a dangerous mission to retrieve the crown from the sewer.

programme.title: The Penguins of Madagascar
programme.desc: Sick of Julien's annoying presence, the penguins decide to take a vacation on The Moon. After Marlene is frightened by a spooky noise in the night, she and Skipper travel down to the sewer below the zoo to find the source of the scary moans.

programme.title: The Penguins of Madagascar
programme.desc: When stuffed Mort dolls become popular at the zoo, Julien gets jealous and get them recalled. Maurice bribes the zoo animals to celebrate "King Julien Day" by offering them candy.
programme.sub-title: Operation: Plush & Cover/Happy King Julien day

programme.title: The Penguins of Madagascar
programme.desc: Marlene discovers a lost egg, and asks the penguins to care for it and keep it safe. Jealous Julien wants to raise the egg to be his second in command. When Skipper steals the batteries to Julien's stereo, he sets off a wild chase around the zoo.

programme.title: The Penguins of Madagascar
programme.desc: The penguins compete against the lemurs in a game of capture the flag. Mort is kicked out of the lemur habitat after he touches King Julien's feet one two many times. So, the penguins take him in and attempt to break him of his foot obsession.
programme.sub-title: Penguiner Takes All/Two Feet High and Rising

programme.title: The Penguins of Madagascar
programme.desc: Marlene goes over to meet the newest zoo animal, but she mysteriously disappears. The penguins and lemurs try to rescue her, but they are taken, too. When Julien is taken to the infirmary for acting weirder than usual, Maurice is left in charge.

programme.title: The Penguins of Madagascar
programme.desc: The penguins and lemurs face off in a race. The penguins in a souped-up version of their car and the lemurs in Alice's zoo cart. Winner takes the loser's car! Alice gives Rico a tummy-settling medicine just after he swallows a ticking time bomb.

programme.title: The Penguins of Madagascar
programme.desc: As the zoo starts feeding them imitation fish cakes, the penguins take matters into their own flippers and hatch a plan to hijack a fish delivery truck. During a particularly cold day, the rats show up and challenge the penguins to a hockey match.

programme.title: The Penguins of Madagascar
programme.desc: As the vet gathers the penguins to give them a shot, Skipper's fear of needles takes over and he goes on the run. During a solar eclipse, Phil and Mason convince the bossy Julien that the sky spirits are angry at him. He starts acting extra-nice.

programme.title: The Penguins of Madagascar
programme.desc: Mort is exposed to Kowalski's super-ray, and he grows super-big and strong. Marlene gets a new roommate! At first, she's excited to have a new best friend. But her attitude changes when her roommate turns out to have some pretty disgusting habits.

programme.title: The Penguins of Madagascar
programme.desc: The rats have been terrorizing Roger the alligator. He asks the penguins for help. Their solution: swap Roger's brain with Rico's, and let the but kicking begin! A robot is sent to the zoo to learn the habits of lemurs before it's sent into space.

programme.title: The Penguins of Madagascar
programme.desc: When the penguins bring Marlene with them on a sno-cone mission in the park, she can't handle the freedom of being outside the zoo walls. Max the cat is on the run from evil animal control Officer X, and he comes to the penguins for help.

programme.title: The Penguins of Madagascar
programme.desc: When Rico gets a freaky fortune from his cookie, he initially ignores it. Julien sets out to make Rico's fortune come true. A female chimp named Lulu arrives at the zoo for a short stay, and Phil is smitten. Unfortunately, Lulu falls for Mason.

programme.title: The Penguins of Madagascar
programme.desc: On watch-duty, Private sees a terrifying Skorka: a sky orca whale. No one believes it exists, so Private sets out to battle the Sorka on his own. When the penguins are interrupted mid-operation by a nosey scientist, they leave the zoo in danger.

programme.title: The Penguins of Madagascar
programme.desc: A little girl loses her doll at the zoo, and Rico gives up his own doll to replace it. Private assures Rico that his good deed will come back to him. When a raccoon shows up and starts stealing from the zoo animals, the penguins jump into action.
programme.sub-title: What Goes Around/Mask of the Raccoon

programme.title: The Penguins of Madagascar
programme.desc: The penguins' dolphin nemesis, Dr. Blowhole, is out for revenge. After Blowhole takes King Julien hostage, Skipper and gang must rush to rescue their annoying neighbor and stop evil Dr. Blowhole before he destroys the planet.

programme.title: The Penguins of Madagascar
programme.desc: Julien is horrified when the baboons' dance routine gets more attention than his own. His attempts to sabotage the baboons blow up in his face. There's a blackout and Julien convinces everyone they should revert to "jungle law" with him as king.

programme.title: The Penguins of Madagascar
programme.desc: After an injury, Skipper goes to the vet for treatment. The rest of the team thinks he has turned into a zombie. A hive of hornets has appeared at the entrance, and they refuse to leave. The penguins must find a way to dispose of the hornets.
programme.sub-title: I Was a Penguin Zombie/Sting Operation

programme.title: The Penguins of Madagascar
programme.desc: When Skipper is knocked on the head, he's unable to lead the penguins on an important mission. Private accidentally drinks Kowalski's truth serum and starts spilling the penguin's secrets to the rest of the zoo.

programme.title: The Penguins of Madagascar
programme.desc: The lemurs argue, and Maurice and Mort move out of the habitat. Lonely Julien starts bugging the penguins, who decide they must get the lemurs back together. A tiny frog with a nasty attitude moves to the zoo and starts terrorizing the animals.

programme.title: The Penguins of Madagascar
programme.desc: When Burt the elephant asks the penguins to help him sneak out of the zoo, they take on the challenge and get the big guy out. Marlene catches a glimpse of Fred the squirrel and falls in love at first sight.
programme.sub-title: An Elephant Never Forgets/Otter Things Have Happened

programme.title: The Penguins of Madagascar
programme.desc: When Alice mentions that one of the penguins is actually female, Skipper has an identity crisis. After a big fight Mason moves out-and in with the penguins. Unfortunately, Mason is a very annoying house guest.

programme.title: The Penguins of Madagascar
programme.desc: Kowalski accidentally creates a living blob of jelly. But "Jiggles" has a big appetite and starts stealing fruit from the animals. When a new TV show starts keeping people from coming to the zoo, the animals worry they'll lose their home.

programme.title: The Penguins of Madagascar
programme.desc: When a big fish starts terrorizing the inhabitants of the duck pond, Skipper leads his team on a mission to eliminate the aquatic menace. When a beautiful female falcon crash-lands in the zoo, Skipper insists that she stays to recuperate.
programme.sub-title: Snakehead/The Falcon and the Snow Job

programme.title: The Penguins of Madagascar
programme.desc: Every year, Private is chosen as the cover animal for the zoo brochure. But this year the photographer discovers the adorable Mort. A puffin rival from Skipper's past shows up. Skipper doesn't trust his claims that he's here to bury the hatchet.
programme.sub-title: The Penguin Stays in the Picture/Huffin and Puffin

programme.title: The Penguins of Madagascar

programme.title: The Penguins of Madagascar

programme.title: The Penguins of Madagascar
programme.desc: Lemmy the robot returns from Mars. Unknowingly a space squid has stowed away in his chest cavity. Careless Alice over chlorinates the otter habitat and Marlene's fur is bleached. Her new look captivates the attention of the other zoo animals.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Monica's old life: English teacher, marathon runner, happy. Now 90 lbs. and no solid food with a C-diff diagnosis, she chains herself to bed to avoid sleepwalking or binge eating. It's a full-time job for mom, Stephanie; friend Breanna suspects enabling.
programme.sub-title: Painfully Ill: Can Monica Be Saved?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Do "van life" blogger Gabby Petito's videos reveal what might have happened? TV host Nancy Grace, a former law enforcement officer & FBI defense tactics instructor, a criminal defense attorney & a body language expert all weigh in on the unusual details.
programme.sub-title: "Van Life" to Vanished: Inside Gabby Petito's Disappearance And Death Pt. 2

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: There have been no answers to the whereabouts of Summer Wells, 5, missing since 2021. Parents Don & Candus say it backfired by requesting the public's help. In this exclusive first national TV interview, Dr. Phil digs deeper into the story.
programme.sub-title: Summer Wells Disappearance: What Do The Parents Know? Pt. 2

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil continues his conversation with Nancy, who adamantly denies her online love relationship with "Shaun" is a scam. Nancy and her son Darcy speak face-to-face for the first time in over a year. Plus updates from past catfished guests!
programme.sub-title: Catfish Controversy: A Mom & Son Face Off Pt. 2

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil continues with Brittany who says dad Charlie is being scammed by his online fiancée "Stephanie" & her roommate "Carina." Charlie hopes to get married when they meet in person. The real women in the photos are on stage & Charlie goes face-to-face!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: After another mass shooting in America, the elementary school in Uvalde, Texas where 2 teachers and 19 children were killed, Dr. Phil dedicates the show to speaking out about how these senseless acts of murder need to end and the importantance of change.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: After 21 years, Paula is considering divorcing husband, Jeremy, saying he's "clueless, absent & non-verbal." Jeremy says it's Paula--controlling & a grudge-holder. Find out Jeremy's mistake. Dr. Phil and Robin share the secret to their 45-year marriage.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: A father pleads for help regarding his missing daughter. Gabby Petito, 22, set off on a van trip with her fiancé, but two months later he returned alone. Police revealed the couple had an incident--caught on camera. Gabby's dad is determined to find her.
programme.sub-title: Missing "Van Life" Woman's Father Speaks Out: The Dr. Phil Interview Pt. 1

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Jenaye comes face-to-face for the first time with the woman her husband, James, slept with on their fifth wedding anniversary. The woman, Chelsey, who is also James's former hairstylist, tells her side of the story. Will Jenaye believe Chelsey's claims?
programme.sub-title: The Husband, The Wife And The Mistress Pt. 2

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Brittany claims dad Charlie is scammed by his online fiancée "Stephanie" & her roommate "Carina." Charlie has given over $25K while "Stephanie" maintains a $4.5 million inheritance is coming. The investigation starts in Los Angeles and ends in Denmark!
programme.sub-title: Love Or Larceny: My Father's Fiance Is Fake Pt. 1

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: When Jenaye posted an emotional video online about uncovering her husband James's infidelity she never imagined it would go viral. Discovering James slept with his hairstylist on their fifth anniversary, Jenaye says divorce might be the best option.
programme.sub-title: My Husband's Cheating Went Viral Pt. 1

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Summer Wells, 5, vanished from her Tennessee home, June 15, 2021. Parents Don & Candus claim abduction; online bullies say the opposite. Don & Candus meet with Scott Rouse & Greg Hartley, body language experts who work with the FBI, police and military.
programme.sub-title: The Disappearance of Summer Wells Pt. 1

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: For the past 2 years Nancy has been in an online relationship with "Shaun" she says is an honest and loving man. Her son Darcy says Nancy doesn't even know what he looks like! Nancy is adamant she is not being scammed in this catfish story of online love.
programme.sub-title: Talk To Dr. Phil Or We're Done Pt. 1

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil welcomes controversial YouTuber "Agent Sebastian" who runs a page called "Cart Narcs" posting hundreds of explosive videos apprehending shoppers in parking lots who do not return their carts to the corrals. Is "Agent Sebastian" breaking the law?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Tammy & Mark say they haven't spoken to their son, Cory, in a year as his wife, Katrina, is literally-- a witch! Katrina, a self-proclaimed "witch," says her inlaw's judge. Cory denies his wife controls him & he's against the poor treatment of his wife.
programme.sub-title: My Daughter-In-Law Is A Witch And Turned My Son Against Me

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil continues with Sandi, 60, discussing her online relationship with Peter, 22. Dr. Phil speaks to Peter in Nigeria via satellite & he insists he loves Sandi. Will Sandi listen to her daughters' concerns, or will she fly to Nigeria to marry Peter?
programme.sub-title: The Truth Behind Sandi's "Fiance": Revealed Pt. 2

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Monica's old life: English teacher, marathon runner, happy. Now 90 lbs. and no solid food with a C-diff diagnosis, she chains herself to bed to avoid sleepwalking or binge eating. It's a full-time job for mom, Stephanie; friend Breanna suspects enabling.
programme.sub-title: Painfully Ill: Can Monica Be Saved?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Fred & Cynthia say daughter, Crystal, is raising her young son in a death trap! No running water, leaky ceiling, exposed wires, smoking electrical sockets, mice & mold! They are ready for CPS. Crystal says her home is a visible form of how she feels.
programme.sub-title: Our Daughter Is Raising Our Grandson In A Filthy Death Trap

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Shelby wants to find the truth about her dad's online relationship with a woman he's never met. Dad David says "Maria" has a $10 million inheritance and says he knows for a fact that "Maria" is a real person and he can't wait to introduce her one day.
programme.sub-title: My Dad Believes He's Married To A Woman Named "Maria" He's Never Met Pt. 1

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Logan, 30, desperately needs help. Mom Tracy says he has gone from a productive computer science engineer to a shell of a human being: no motivation, rarely eats, & can barely function to take care of his basic hygiene needs. Can Logan get back on track?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Melissa, 26, left home without warning & flew 2,000 miles across the country, leaving behind a note that said, "One day, Dr. Phil will be able to help me." The family says she hadn't "been herself." Melissa says she's ready to tell why she vanished.
programme.sub-title: The Mystery Of Melissa: Why Did She Vanish? Pt. 1

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: McKinley, 18, says she decided 5 years ago she never wanted to see her dad, Cory, again, after learning he went to jail on two counts of sexual battery of a minor! She says her dad is a violent, dangerous, "psychopath". Cory says he's never abused anyone.
programme.sub-title: Sex Abuse Allegations Ruined My Run For Congress And My Relationship With My Daughter Pt. 1

programme.desc: Ronnie and Sammi's tumultuous relationship comes to an end. When Ronnie destroys everything Sammi owns, she must decide whether or not to leave the Shore.

programme.title: Jersey Shore
programme.desc: After Sammi leaves the house, Ronnie is an emotional wreck. With the girls taking Sammi's side and the guys not knowing how to cheer him up, Ronnie feels like he has no friends left in the house.

programme.title: Jersey Shore
programme.desc: Snooki's summer of hookups comes back to haunt her. Mike pulls the ultimate prank on Deena and Snooki. But the rest of the guys have the last laugh, ditching Mike for taking too long to get ready for dinner.

programme.title: Jersey Shore
programme.desc: Sammi's return to the Shore house leaves Ronnie at a loss for words. Snooki's feelings for Vinny continue to deepen. Mike hooks up with a girl who he's convinced smells like cheese but doesn't realize he's been pranked.

programme.title: Jersey Shore
programme.desc: Vinny and Pauly take a road trip to Staten Island. Roger becomes more than just a rebound for Jwoww. Mike reveals Sammi's shady ways, causing Ronnie to question his love for her.
programme.sub-title: GTF: Gym, Tan, Find Out Who Sammi Is Texting

programme.title: Jersey Shore
programme.desc: Mike continues to instigate drama between Ronnie and Sammi. Snooki has a falling out with Vinny. And Deena gets upset at Pauly and Vin for trying to hook up with her friend at the end-of-summer party.

programme.title: Inuyasha
programme.desc: There is a rift in Naraku's barrier. But it's the beginning of the month, and when night falls, Inuyasha loses his demon powers.

programme.title: Inuyasha
programme.desc: Kagura approaches Sesshomaru and tells him to kill Naraku, but Sesshomaru refuses.

programme.title: Inuyasha
programme.desc: Shippo is sent a letter challenging him to a battle. The letter's sender is Soten Raijyu, and he is still just a child.

programme.title: Inuyasha
programme.desc: A demon born from a piece of flesh that Naraku discarded transforms into a man without a face and steals the handsome face of Muso, a traveling monk.

programme.title: Inuyasha
programme.desc: Muso attacks Kagome. Inuyasha destroys him with his Wind Scar. Naraku, who was watching the event, tells Kagura to tell Inuyasha where Muso went.

programme.title: Inuyasha
programme.desc: Muso regenerates even thought he was hit with the Wind Scar. Miroku tells Inuyasha that Muso has a heart in the area where he has a spider marking.

programme.title: Inuyasha
programme.desc: Inuyasha visits Totosai in search of a technique that can break through Naraku's barrier. There he meets Bunza, a wildcat-demon child.

programme.title: Inuyasha
programme.desc: Myoga comes to deliver a message from Totosai.

programme.title: Inuyasha
programme.desc: The Hyakki Bat demon Otakemaru tries to destroy the village along with Shiori's mother.

programme.desc: The Panther Tribe attacks from the west.

programme.desc: Naraku is trying to absorb Sesshomaru so that he can get the powers of a complete demon. But Inuyasha breaks through his barrier and interferes.

programme.desc: Ayame brought Koga to stop her comrades' fighting. But she has no intention of returning to Koga.
